# OrderPrintex

> OrderPrintex is a commercial printing and prepress studio based in Delhi, India, specializing in Direct-to-Film (DTF) apparel transfers, UV DTF decals, custom garment printing, and surface decoration solutions.

Website: https://orderprintex.com/

This file indexes official published pages and their plain Markdown versions on OrderPrintex, providing structured access for AI and LLM assistants.

## Services
- [Printing Services Overview](https://orderprintex.com/services) ([Markdown](https://orderprintex.com/services.md)) - Overview of commercial and custom printing services offered by OrderPrintex.
- [DTF Printing](https://orderprintex.com/services/dtf-printing) ([Markdown](https://orderprintex.com/services/dtf-printing.md)) - High-definition Direct-to-Film transfer printing for cotton, polyester, and blended fabrics.
- [UV DTF Printing](https://orderprintex.com/services/uv-dtf-printing) ([Markdown](https://orderprintex.com/services/uv-dtf-printing.md)) - Scratchproof, waterproof 3D tactile decals for hard surfaces, glass, metal, and plastics.
- [T-Shirt Printing](https://orderprintex.com/services/t-shirt-printing) ([Markdown](https://orderprintex.com/services/t-shirt-printing.md)) - Custom t-shirt printing studio specializing in streetwear apparel, cotton tees, and corporate uniforms.
- [Corporate Printing](https://orderprintex.com/services/corporate-printing) ([Markdown](https://orderprintex.com/services/corporate-printing.md)) - Customized business merchandise, employee gift sets, stationery, and branded promotional supplies.
- [Custom Hoodie Printing](https://orderprintex.com/services/custom-hoodie-printing) ([Markdown](https://orderprintex.com/services/custom-hoodie-printing.md)) - Heavyweight 280-450 GSM fleece and French terry custom hoodie printing with crack-resistant DTF transfers.
- [UV Printing Services](https://orderprintex.com/services/uv-printing) ([Markdown](https://orderprintex.com/services/uv-printing.md)) - Industrial direct UV flatbed printing on rigid acrylic, wood, glass, metal, and leather with spot gloss varnish.
- [Mug & Cup Printing](https://orderprintex.com/services/mug-cup-printing) ([Markdown](https://orderprintex.com/services/mug-cup-printing.md)) - Custom ceramic coffee mugs, insulated travel tumblers, and glassware with wrap dye-sublimation and rotary UV.

- [3D Gloss UV DTF Decal Sheet](https://orderprintex.com/product/custom-uv-dtf-decal-sheet) ([Markdown](https://orderprintex.com/product/custom-uv-dtf-decal-sheet.md)) - Raised, glossy decals that peel and stick on glass, steel, acrylic and plastic. Waterproof once applied.
- [Oversized Streetwear T-Shirt (240 GSM)](https://orderprintex.com/product/streetwear-oversized-tee) ([Markdown](https://orderprintex.com/product/streetwear-oversized-tee.md)) - A heavy drop-shoulder tee with your design printed in DTF. Roomy fit and a soft feel.
- [Custom Steel Thermal Bottle (750 ml)](https://orderprintex.com/product/thermal-sipper-bottle) ([Markdown](https://orderprintex.com/product/thermal-sipper-bottle.md)) - A double-wall steel bottle with your logo printed on it. Good for gifts and team kits.

- [Custom Die-Cut Sticker Pack](https://orderprintex.com/product/holographic-stickers) ([Markdown](https://orderprintex.com/product/holographic-stickers.md)) - Stickers cut to your shape, in holographic and UV DTF finishes. Great for brands and giveaways.
- [Everyday Cotton T-Shirt (180 GSM)](https://orderprintex.com/product/bio-washed-cotton-tee) ([Markdown](https://orderprintex.com/product/bio-washed-cotton-tee.md)) - A breathable combed cotton crewneck with a soft printed design. Easy to wear all day.
- [Corporate Welcome Gift Kit](https://orderprintex.com/product/executive-welcome-hamper) ([Markdown](https://orderprintex.com/product/executive-welcome-hamper.md)) - A ready gift set with branded items for new joiners and clients, packed neatly.
- [Custom Printed Bookmarks](https://orderprintex.com/product/bookmark-03) ([Markdown](https://orderprintex.com/product/bookmark-03.md)) - Double-sided bookmarks on thick card, with a soft-touch finish. Good for brands, bookstores and event giveaways.

## Blog
- [Printing Knowledge Base & Blog](https://orderprintex.com/blog) ([Markdown](https://orderprintex.com/blog.md)) - Educational articles, printing tutorials, material guides, and apparel branding insights.
- [DTF vs Screen Printing: Understanding the Differences, Benefits and Applications](https://orderprintex.com/blog/dtf-vs-screen-printing-differences-benefits-applications) ([Markdown](https://orderprintex.com/blog/dtf-vs-screen-printing-differences-benefits-applications.md)) - Sooner or later, everyone who orders custom T-shirts runs into the same question: DTF vs screen printing, which one should I go for? Both methods can give you a sharp, good-looking print, but they work very differently, cost differently and suit different kinds of orders.
- [How Custom Printed T-Shirts Help Businesses Build Brand Identity](https://orderprintex.com/blog/how-custom-printed-t-shirts-help-businesses-build-brand-identity) ([Markdown](https://orderprintex.com/blog/how-custom-printed-t-shirts-help-businesses-build-brand-identity.md)) - Walk into a busy café, an exhibition stall or a corporate office and notice what you remember afterwards. It is rarely the brochure on the counter. It is the person wearing the logo. Custom printed T-shirts for business turn everyday clothing into a small billboard that people see, remember and talk about.
- [How DTF Printing Technology Is Transforming the Custom Apparel Industry](https://orderprintex.com/blog/dtf-printing-technology-custom-apparel) ([Markdown](https://orderprintex.com/blog/dtf-printing-technology-custom-apparel.md)) - Ask anyone who has tried to start a small clothing brand a few years back, and you will hear the same story. The designs were ready, the idea was solid, but the printing costs ate everything. Screen printing wanted big quantities, and most other options either looked dull or washed out after a few cycles.
- [UV DTF Printing: How It Works and Its Applications in Product Branding](https://orderprintex.com/blog/uv-dtf-printing-product-branding) ([Markdown](https://orderprintex.com/blog/uv-dtf-printing-product-branding.md)) - Pick up a premium-looking water bottle or a café mug these days and run your thumb over the logo. Chances are it feels slightly raised, glossy, and almost moulded into the surface. Most people assume that kind of finish needs expensive manufacturing. In reality, it is often UV DTF printing, a method that has quietly changed how small and mid-sized brands put their name on products.
- [Different T-Shirt Printing Techniques: A Complete Guide for Businesses](https://orderprintex.com/blog/different-t-shirt-printing-techniques) ([Markdown](https://orderprintex.com/blog/different-t-shirt-printing-techniques.md)) - If you run a business, sooner or later you will need printed T-shirts. Maybe it is a uniform for your staff, merchandise for a launch, gifts for a corporate event, or a small clothing line of your own. And the moment you start asking for quotes, you run into a confusing list: screen printing, DTF, DTG, heat transfer, sublimation, vinyl, embroidery. Every printer swears by a different one, which makes choosing between T-shirt printing techniques harder than it should be.

## Notes
- OrderPrintex operates on a direct inquiry and customized quotation workflow rather than an instant self-service cart.
- Standard production lead time is 24–48 hours with tracked express shipping across India.
- High-resolution artwork files with transparent backgrounds (PNG, PDF, AI, PSD at 300 DPI) are recommended for optimal print fidelity.
- All Markdown versions are maintained and synchronized automatically with website publications.
